questions.name: q1_what_can_i_do
questions.question: What can I do at Engineer Cafe?
questions.answer: You can attend events or work in the Main Hall using free Wi-Fi and power strips while accessing our latest tech like Apple Vision Pro. Additionally, you may visit the B1F fabrication lab to use 3D printers and laser cutters, or book a meeting room on the second floor.

questions.name: q2_where_is_toilet
questions.question: Where is the toilet?
questions.answer: The restrooms are located on the first-floor terrace behind the reception desk; you cannot access them directly from inside the building, so please go out to the far end of the terrace. Western-style toilets with warm-water bidets are available there, though note that there is no dedicated diaper-changing space.

questions.name: q3_cafe_open_weekend
questions.question: Is the cafe open on weekends?
questions.answer: Yes, Cafe SAINO is open on both Saturdays and Sundays according to our schedule. The hours are 18:00-20:00 during these weekend days.
